hardware: 8 x H800 (80 GB), one node, Qwen3.5-9B

gate_only.note: the repair the logged warning points at. It removes the semaphore wait and does not help: the queueing relocates into the shared 20-connection pool, where more concurrent setups now also compete with running trajectories' tool calls.

pool_only.note: the unlogged limit is the binding one; lifting it alone clears the threshold with 22 s of margin.

cpu_calibration.note: 256 trajectories against the same sandbox service on CPU, no GPU, same ordering

caveats: one run per arm; the spread between the unrepaired and gate_only arms (55 s) bounds the run-to-run noise, so the threshold is placed 40 s below the weakest passing arm and 134 s above the strongest failing one
the arms differ only in the sandbox client's environment; model, topology, training, rollout and the sandbox service are identical
